operatingSystems.setup: export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive && apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates curl git sudo bash procps less nano unzip xz-utils python3 python3-venv build-essential wget jq ripgrep fd-find tree btop tmux mc vim zip openssh-client rsync git-lfs file gnupg && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* && ln -sf /usr/bin/fdfind /usr/local/bin/fd

export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive && apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates curl git sudo bash procps less nano unzip xz-utils python3 python3-venv build-essential wget jq ripgrep fd-find tree btop tmux mc vim zip openssh-client rsync git-lfs file gnupg && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* && ln -sf /usr/bin/fdfind /usr/local/bin/fd

dnf install -y --allowerasing ca-certificates curl git sudo bash procps-ng less nano unzip xz tar gzip which findutils python3 gcc gcc-c++ make wget jq ripgrep fd-find tree btop tmux mc vim-enhanced zip openssh-clients rsync git-lfs file gnupg2 && dnf clean all

pacman-key --init && pacman-key --populate archlinux manjaro && pacman -Syu --noconfirm --needed ca-certificates curl git sudo bash procps-ng less nano unzip xz tar gzip which python base-devel wget jq ripgrep fd tree btop tmux mc vim zip openssh rsync git-lfs file gnupg && pacman -Scc --noconfirm

commonSetup: arch=$(uname -m); case "$arch" in x86_64) arch=x64 ;; aarch64) arch=arm64 ;; esac; tarball=$(curl -fsSL https://nodejs.org/dist/latest-v24.x/SHASUMS256.txt | awk '{print $2}' | grep -E "^node-v[0-9.]+-linux-$arch\.tar\.xz$"); curl -fsSL "https://nodejs.org/dist/latest-v24.x/$tarball" | tar -xJ -C /usr/local --strip-components=1 --exclude=CHANGELOG.md --exclude=LICENSE --exclude=README.md && node --version && npm --version

arch=$(uname -m); case "$arch" in x86_64) arch=amd64 ;; aarch64) arch=arm64 ;; esac; curl -fsSL "https://github.com/JanDeDobbeleer/oh-my-posh/releases/latest/download/posh-linux-$arch" -o /usr/local/bin/oh-my-posh && chmod 0755 /usr/local/bin/oh-my-posh && oh-my-posh version
userSetup: grep -q 'oh-my-posh init' ~/.bashrc 2>/dev/null || echo '[[ $- == *i* ]] && command -v oh-my-posh >/dev/null && eval "$(oh-my-posh init bash)"' >> ~/.bashrc
